description: This file contains FastAPI route definitions and associated logic for authentication functions within a backend API. It includes endpoints for OAuth login flow initiation, callback handling, token refresh, and API key management. The code leverages various dependencies and utilities for secure token handling, rate limiting, and tenant-specific data operations.

classes.name: OAuthLoginRequest
classes.description: Request model for starting an OAuth login flow, specifying connector details, tenant, redirect URI, and scopes.

classes.name: OAuthLoginResponse
classes.description: Response containing the authorization URL and state token for OAuth login.

classes.name: OAuthCallbackResponse
classes.description: Response after OAuth callback processing, indicating success or failure and token expiry.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshRequest
classes.description: Request model for refreshing an OAuth access token using a stored refresh token.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshResponse
classes.description: Response indicating the result of a token refresh, including new expiry info.

classes.name: ApiKeyUpsertRequest
classes.description: Request model for storing or updating an API key for a specific connection.

classes.name: ApiKeyVerifyRequest
classes.description: Request to verify a provided API key against a stored hash.

classes.name: ApiKeyResponse
classes.description: Standard response format indicating the result of API key operations.

classes.name: OAuthState
classes.description: TypedDict representing the payload stored in the OAuth 'state' parameter for validation.

methods.name: _tenant_tokens_collection(tenant_id: str)
methods.description: Helper to get the MongoDB collection for tenant-specific tokens.

methods.name: bytes _aad(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Generate a unique contextual ciphertext binding tenant and connection IDs.

methods.name: Optional[datetime] _upsert_oauth_tokens( *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, access_token: str, refresh_token: Optional[str], expires_in: Optional[int], )
methods.description: Insert or update OAuth tokens in tenant-specific storage, encrypting tokens.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _get_oauth_record(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve existing OAuth token record for tenant and connection.

methods.name: None _upsert_api_key( *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, api_key_plain: str, header_name: Optional[str], prefix: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Store or update an API key hash and metadata in tenant storage.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _get_api_key_record(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve stored API key hash record.

methods.name: ApiKeyResponse set_api_key_async(req: ApiKeyUpsertRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Async handler to store API key, ensuring proper rate limiting and tenant validation.

methods.name: ApiKeyResponse verify_api_key_route(req: ApiKeyVerifyRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Verify provided API key against stored hash, with rate limiting and auditing.

methods.name: OAuthLoginResponse oauth_login(req: OAuthLoginRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Initiate OAuth flow, generate authorization URL and state, and audit action.

methods.name: OAuthCallbackResponse oauth_callback( request: Request, code: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Authorization code returned by the provider."), state: str = Query(..., description="Opaque state parameter returned by the provider."), error: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional error returned by provider."), error_description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional error description."), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Handle OAuth provider redirect, exchange code for tokens, store tokens securely, and audit.

methods.name: OAuthRefreshResponse oauth_refresh(req: OAuthRefreshRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Use stored refresh token to obtain new access token, update storage, and audit.
